items.title: Still water
items.body: The lake has gone dead still. It holds the full moon whole and gives back every star above it, black glass from shore to shore. On the map, too, the water lies unmoving, the moon's path laid straight across it.

items.title: Twelve seats around the lake
items.body: Nullmere Online is one realm, shared by every keeper. Enter under a name of your choosing and hold one of twelve seats. Each watch, every House's orders are carried out together: pacts, gifts, trade, war. The realm opens with the first release.

items.title: A full moon over Nullmere
items.body: The launcher now opens on the lake under a full moon. The water moves, the stars flicker, and now and then one falls. Play, News, Settings and the repository live here while the first realm is shaped.

items.title: Made for Apple Intelligence
items.body: Nullmere runs on Macs with Apple silicon and macOS 26 or later, with Apple Intelligence turned on. Its characters will speak through Apple's on-device model, so the launcher checks that your Mac has it before you cross.

items.title: Out of Warpkeep
items.body: Nullmere keeps Warpkeep's universe, principles and rules core, and leaves its Farcaster identity behind. The notes on what carries over are in the repository.
